questions.question:
Should Relay v1 let users create and delete context markdown files from the UI, or only browse and edit files they add on disk?

Why it matters: Splits the epic into a browse/edit-only slice versus a fuller CRUD feature with filesystem APIs, validation, and sidebar actions.
Recommended answer: Browse and edit only in v1: list `.relay/context/*.md`, open modal with Preview/Edit, save via Relay APIs; users add or remove files through Finder/terminal until a follow-up slice adds in-app create/delete.
